namespace Eleph\SQLite\Manifest;

use Eleph\SQLite\Sql\{Column, EdgePlacement, Index, TableSchema};
use Eleph\Runtime\Storage\RelationKind;

return new StorageManifest(
    tables: [
        'Author' => new TableSchema(
            'phe_author',
            [
                'id' => new Column('id', 'INTEGER', false, true, null),
                'name' => new Column('name', 'TEXT', false, false, null),
            ],
            [

            ],
            'id',
        ),
        'Comment' => new TableSchema(
            'phe_comment',
            [
                'id' => new Column('id', 'INTEGER', false, true, null),
                'body' => new Column('body', 'TEXT', false, false, null),
                'author_id' => new Column('author_id', 'INTEGER', true, false, null),
                'post_id' => new Column('post_id', 'INTEGER', true, false, null),
            ],
            [
                'phe_comment_author_id_idx' => new Index('phe_comment_author_id_idx', ['author_id'], false),
                'phe_comment_post_id_idx' => new Index('phe_comment_post_id_idx', ['post_id'], false),
            ],
            'id',
        ),
        'Post' => new TableSchema(
            'phe_post',
            [
                'id' => new Column('id', 'INTEGER', false, true, null),
                'created_at' => new Column('created_at', 'TEXT', false, false, null),
                'updated_at' => new Column('updated_at', 'TEXT', false, false, null),
                'post_id' => new Column('post_id', 'INTEGER', true, false, null),
                'slug' => new Column('slug', 'TEXT', false, false, null),
                'title' => new Column('title', 'TEXT', false, false, null),
                'price' => new Column('price', 'INTEGER', true, false, null),
                'status' => new Column('status', 'TEXT', false, false, null),
                'visibility' => new Column('visibility', 'TEXT', false, false, null),
                'published_at' => new Column('published_at', 'TEXT', true, false, null),
                'extra_int' => new Column('extra_int', 'INTEGER', true, false, null),
                'extra_float' => new Column('extra_float', 'REAL', true, false, null),
                'extra_bool' => new Column('extra_bool', 'INTEGER', true, false, null),
                'extra_json' => new Column('extra_json', 'TEXT', true, false, null),
                'extra_id' => new Column('extra_id', 'INTEGER', true, false, null),
                'featured_author_id' => new Column('featured_author_id', 'INTEGER', true, false, null),
            ],
            [
                'phe_post_post_id_uniq' => new Index('phe_post_post_id_uniq', ['post_id'], true),
                'phe_post_title_idx' => new Index('phe_post_title_idx', ['title'], false),
                'phe_post_featured_author_id_uniq' => new Index('phe_post_featured_author_id_uniq', ['featured_author_id'], true),
            ],
            'id',
        ),
        'Tag' => new TableSchema(
            'phe_tag',
            [
                'id' => new Column('id', 'INTEGER', false, true, null),
                'label' => new Column('label', 'TEXT', false, false, null),
            ],
            [
                'phe_tag_label_uniq' => new Index('phe_tag_label_uniq', ['label'], true),
            ],
            'id',
        ),
    ],
    placements: [
        'Comment.author' => new EdgePlacement('Comment', 'author', 'Author', RelationKind::ManyToOne, 'phe_comment', 'author_id', null, 'phe_author'),
        'Post.comments' => new EdgePlacement('Post', 'comments', 'Comment', RelationKind::OneToMany, 'phe_comment', 'post_id', null, 'phe_comment'),
        'Post.tags' => new EdgePlacement('Post', 'tags', 'Tag', RelationKind::ManyToMany, 'phe_post_tags', 'post_id', 'tag_id', 'phe_tag'),
        'Post.related' => new EdgePlacement('Post', 'related', 'Post', RelationKind::ManyToMany, 'phe_post_related', 'post_id', 'related_id', 'phe_post'),
        'Post.featuredAuthor' => new EdgePlacement('Post', 'featuredAuthor', 'Author', RelationKind::OneToOne, 'phe_post', 'featured_author_id', null, 'phe_author'),
    ],
    columns: [
        'Author' => ['name' => 'name'],
        'Comment' => ['body' => 'body'],
        'Post' => ['createdAt' => 'created_at', 'updatedAt' => 'updated_at', 'postId' => 'post_id', 'slug' => 'slug', 'title' => 'title', 'price' => 'price', 'status' => 'status', 'visibility' => 'visibility', 'publishedAt' => 'published_at', 'extraInt' => 'extra_int', 'extraFloat' => 'extra_float', 'extraBool' => 'extra_bool', 'extraJson' => 'extra_json', 'extraId' => 'extra_id'],
        'Tag' => ['label' => 'label'],
    ],
    joinTables: [
        'phe_post_related' => new TableSchema(
            'phe_post_related',
            [
                'post_id' => new Column('post_id', 'INTEGER', false, false, null),
                'related_id' => new Column('related_id', 'INTEGER', false, false, null),
            ],
            [
                'phe_post_related_pair_uniq' => new Index('phe_post_related_pair_uniq', ['post_id', 'related_id'], true),
                'phe_post_related_related_id_idx' => new Index('phe_post_related_related_id_idx', ['related_id'], false),
            ],
            '',
        ),
        'phe_post_tags' => new TableSchema(
            'phe_post_tags',
            [
                'post_id' => new Column('post_id', 'INTEGER', false, false, null),
                'tag_id' => new Column('tag_id', 'INTEGER', false, false, null),
            ],
            [
                'phe_post_tags_pair_uniq' => new Index('phe_post_tags_pair_uniq', ['post_id', 'tag_id'], true),
                'phe_post_tags_tag_id_idx' => new Index('phe_post_tags_tag_id_idx', ['tag_id'], false),
            ],
            '',
        ),
    ],
);
